text:
maya: Figma link + quick ask: trying a compact run-history variant that highlights schema pinning, tiny inline diff markers, and a lightweight export flow (CSV/Gist). thoughts?

diego: initial thumbs. main UX q: do we let users pin a schema to the whole session or per-run? pin-to-session feels useful for repeatable evals.

zhen: prefer session pin + per-run override. implementation: pin stored in local state + optional backend tag when user wants to snapshot. avoids extra fetch on each render.

miko: small perf note: showing diffs for every run might be heavy if we compute JSON diffs client-side. proposal: show a 1px orange delta bar on runs with changed output and compute full diff on expand. cheap sentinel vs full compute.

maya: agree sentinel + expand compute. visually the bar could be 3px and placed left of item; tapping expands an inline diff panel.

ava-a11y: a11y notes: ensure delta bar has accessible name (e.g., aria-label="output changed") and provide a keyboard shortcut to jump to next changed run (alt+]). Also announce when a pinned schema changes contextually. color contrast for orange bar must meet 3:1 for non-text, but include a textual tag too for screen readers.

diego: good catch. for keyboard nav, we should add global quick keys: r = re-run focused, e = expand schema, p = pin/unpin. documentation for shortcuts in the console help.

zhen: copy nits: 'Pin schema' vs 'Lock schema' — prefer 'Pin' (less scary). For export, label button 'Export runs' and inside choose CSV / JSON / Gist.

miko: export mechanics: for CSV we flatten run metadata (id,timestamp,latency,tokens,tool,result-summary). Gist export should ask for public/private and attach full run JSON. we must warn about sensitive data if customer uses private tools. add modal checkbox "remove PII" that runs a scrubber before export.

maya: product wants quick cost signal inline: tiny token count + estimated cost (muted). show per-run cost tooltip showing model/quantization assumptions.

diego: backend already provides token counts but cost calc depends on model; client can compute estimate using the model id and a pricing table. keep all labels subdued.

ava-a11y: more: ensure the export modal is focus-trapped and that the scrub checkbox has descriptive text about what it removes. Gist link should be focusable and announced after creation.

zhen: mobile behavior: kebab menu becomes full-width bottom sheet on small screens. running actions should be easy to reach with thumbs (big tap targets).

miko: about long strings in outputs: add toggle 'wrap long outputs' in the run list. default: no wrap for code blocks, wrap for plain text. this helps scanning.

diego: copy tweak: use 'View schema' not 'Show schema' for consistency with other console labels. also 'Compare with previous' for diff action.

maya: telemetry ask: track pin/unpin, export-type, and diff-open events. annotate runs with a boolean 'diff_seen' in our logs so we can understand which diffs are useful.

zhen: logging note: keep telemetry opt-outable at org level. avoid logging raw outputs in analytics.

ava-a11y: final checklist for implementation PR: semantic list structure, roving tabindex for run items, aria-live for streaming start/end, focus trap for export modal, keyboard shortcuts documented, delta bar has accessible label.

miko: dev tasks: 1) sentinel delta bar + expand diff compute 2) pin state UX + session storage 3) export modal + scrubber 4) wrap toggle + mobile sheet 5) add small tokens/cost label 6) keyboard shortcuts. estimate 5-7 dev days.

maya: timeline: mock updates by Wed, dev estimate by EOD Mon, small usability session Thurs. will upload updated PNG + figma link. ops-bot: can you attach a11y scan when Maya uploads?

ops-bot: file-uploaded: compact-run-history-export-v2.png -> a11y-scan queued (report will post to thread).

maya: thanks all, leaving the mock comments in Figma. will follow up with a short demo in Thurs UX sync. :sparkles:
